The shop

Built here.

K-TECH Speedshop is a C10 shop. Custom builds, parts we machine or kit ourselves, merch, and trucks that need a new owner. The site exists so people can find the work without a paid ad and without a 2005 auto-dealer template.

Drop your real shop story, city, and hours into this page when you are ready. Until then, Instagram is the live floor and email is how a build starts.
